To the recent events that have us concerned, e.g.:

  • Joe Biggs being fired from InfoWars
  • InfoWars deleting videos, backing away from #PizzaGate
  • Flynn, Jr. being fired from transition team
  • The severe push for censoring #FakeNews
  • The Senate push to keep the FCC under Democrat control (FCC governs the Internet now, recall)
  • Milo's "not yet" comments about adressing #PizzaGate and suggestion he's been asked to BTFO ... for now.
  • The Comet Ping Pong shooter

I'm attempting to apply Occam's Razor to what I see are 3 primary scenarios:

  1. Pressure has descended from the accused in the form of significant legal action. That is, those whose reputation is impugned by the #PizzaGate flap have brought real indication of serious legal notice of intent. I would keep watching the typical legal postings channels in DC primarily to see what materializes. At this point, it would be private channel, so there will not be much evidence apart from indirect evidence (people unwilling to speak about #PizzaGate or generally going silent).

  2. Pressure from the Trump administration to BTFO. This one is potentially more troubling, if it's not also including the 3rd scenario I mention. This would be ultimately from Trump himself, but certainly direction from Priebus (a skilled attorney, BTW). Evidence of this is Flynn, Jr being fired. I'm guessing that Trump, through Priebus or Pence (though perhaps personally) asked Jones to terminate Biggs as a sacrifice to the vestiges of power that remain. Is it a forever termination or just a stunt until Trump is in office and this blows over?

  3. A real, serious, professional investigation is being actively performed by the FBI. This is of course the scenario we all want. I have been looking for signs of this - activity and comments from people who would know. The first sign of this (potentially) I saw was Milo's comments about being called from several telephone numbers with DC area codes and asked to defer speaking on #PizzaGate until a later time. AND HE COMPLIED. When has Milo complied with someone asking him not to speak on a subject? Seriously.

Ultimately, this boils down to 2 more serious possibilities, IMO:

  1. All the power players we deem on "our side" are honoring Trump's direct entreaties to BTFO of #PizzaGate. This is independent of any investigation by the FBI & is completely because of optics and Trump's desire to enter office without what is seen as a sideshow. It is purely a business decision. Flynn & Biggs were distracting from business and exhibiting poor judgment.

  2. There's a very real investigation ongoing and is close to issuing indictments / making arrests. Trump's team has been informed of it and is making preparations for dealing with it. Milo's comments are supportive of this theorem. Getting rid of Biggs & Flynn Jr is a sign they are distancing the Trump admin from the issue to give the FBI the focus.

My best guess is it's #1, while I'm hoping for #2.
